introduction.title: Introduction
introduction.content: Recipe App ("we", "us", "our", or the "Service") is committed to protecting your privacy. This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, and protect your personal data when you use our web application. We comply with the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) and other applicable privacy laws.

authentication.title: Authentication Data
authentication.content: When you sign up or log in, your email address and authentication information are collected by Clerk (our authentication provider). We receive only your user ID from Clerk — we do not store passwords or sensitive authentication details. Clerk is responsible for secure password management.

recipes.title: Recipes and Cooking Data
recipes.content: When you create recipes, we store: recipe title, description, difficulty level, cooking time, ingredients, instructions, and any tags you assign. This data is stored in Supabase (our database provider) and is associated with your user ID.

shoppingLists.title: Shopping Lists
shoppingLists.content: We store shopping lists you create, including item names, quantities, units, and checked status. You can also invite others to collaborate on lists — we store their user IDs as list members.

legalBasis.title: Legal Basis for Processing
legalBasis.content: We process your personal data based on your consent (GDPR Article 6(1)(a)). By using the Service, you consent to this Privacy Policy. You may withdraw consent at any time by deleting your account.

thirdParty.title: Third-Party Services
thirdParty.clerk: Clerk (clerk.com) handles user authentication, sign-up, and account management. Clerk is GDPR-compliant and their Privacy Policy governs how they handle authentication data. Visit clerk.com/privacy for details.
thirdParty.supabase: Supabase (supabase.com) hosts our PostgreSQL database in the EU, ensuring GDPR compliance. Your recipes, shopping lists, and account associations are stored there. Supabase's Privacy Policy and Data Processing Agreement govern their role. Visit supabase.com/privacy for details.

future.title: Future Services
future.content: We may add error monitoring (e.g., Sentry) in the future to improve reliability. Any new services will be GDPR-compliant, and this Privacy Policy will be updated accordingly.

retention.title: Data Retention
retention.content: When you delete your account, all your personal data is deleted immediately from our systems (recipes, shopping lists, collections). Clerk and Supabase also delete their copies per their retention policies. No backups of your data are kept beyond standard infrastructure redundancy (typically 7-30 days).

rights.title: Your Rights Under GDPR
rights.access: Right to access: You can request all personal data we hold about you.
rights.rectification: Right to rectification: You can correct inaccurate data.
rights.erasure: Right to erasure ("right to be forgotten"): You can request deletion of your account and data by going to Settings → Delete Account.
rights.restriction: Right to restrict processing: You can request we limit how we use your data.
rights.portability: Right to data portability: You can request your data in a portable format.
rights.objection: Right to object: You can object to processing of your data (though limited by our legitimate interests).

exerciseRights.title: How to Exercise Your Rights
exerciseRights.content: To exercise any of these rights, contact us via email. Please include your user ID and the specific right you wish to exercise. We will respond within 30 days (as required by GDPR). You can also delete your account directly via the Settings page.

security.title: Data Security
security.content: We use industry-standard security measures: all data is transmitted over HTTPS, passwords are managed by Clerk (hashed and salted), and database access is restricted to authenticated users. However, no system is 100% secure. We recommend using a strong, unique password and enabling two-factor authentication (2FA) in your Clerk account.

changes.title: Changes to This Policy
changes.content: We may update this Privacy Policy periodically. Material changes will be communicated via email. Your continued use of the Service after changes constitutes acceptance of the updated policy.
